title: Students protest in Turbat over shooting of female students

tea.why: Protesters condemned the armed shooting of three female students at Girls Degree College Nushki.
tea.want: Demonstrators demanded justice for the victims, accountability for the attackers, and enhanced safety for students.
tea.changed: Nov 1: Students organised a protest at the University of Turbat to demand accountability and safety.

summary: Students gathered at the University of Turbat in Balochistan to condemn an armed attack on female students at Girls Degree College Nushki. Organised by the Baloch Students Action Committee's Turbat zone, the demonstration drew a large number of male and female participants who carried placards denouncing the incident and voicing concern over security threats to the academic community. The underlying shooting occurred when unidentified masked gunmen opened fire on the college premises, injuring three female students, one of whom was transferred to Quetta for specialised medical treatment. Sources reported no official government or police response regarding the protest actions in the provided texts.
demands: Enhanced safety for students and the academic community
response: No official response reported in the sources.

injuries.text: Three female students sustained injuries in the attack

updates.text: Unidentified masked gunmen opened fire at Girls Degree College Nushki, injuring three female students.
The Baloch Students Action Committee organised a protest at the University of Turbat.
